_meta.author: Claude (draft written from label names and sampled utterances)
_meta.style: 'The user ...' sentences. family = HWU 'scenario' (derived from the label prefix, not from this file).
_meta.notes: 63 labels. The canonical HWU64 has 64: the 4 rare labels (general_greet, music_dislikeness, audio_volume_other, cooking_query; <=25 examples) and general_quirky (catch-all for unusual requests) are excluded in the build config. general_* labels are conversational acts about the assistant's previous behaviour (affirm = 'you understood me correctly', confirm = 'please check/confirm what I said', explain = 'I did not understand, please rephrase').

alarm_query.description: The user asks which alarms they have set.

alarm_remove.description: The user wants to cancel or remove an alarm.

alarm_set.description: The user wants to set an alarm.

audio_volume_down.description: The user wants to lower the volume.

audio_volume_mute.description: The user wants to mute the sound.

audio_volume_up.description: The user wants to raise the volume.

calendar_query.description: The user asks about events or meetings in their calendar.

calendar_remove.description: The user wants to delete an event from their calendar.

calendar_set.description: The user wants to add an event or reminder to their calendar.

cooking_recipe.description: The user asks for a recipe or what to cook.

datetime_convert.description: The user wants to convert a time between time zones.

datetime_query.description: The user asks for the current time or date.

email_addcontact.description: The user wants to add someone to their email contacts.

email_query.description: The user asks about their emails, for example new or unread messages.

email_querycontact.description: The user asks for the contact details of a person.

email_sendemail.description: The user wants to write and send an email.

general_affirm.description: The user confirms that the assistant understood the request correctly.

general_commandstop.description: The user wants the assistant to stop or cancel what it is doing.

general_confirm.description: The user asks the assistant to check and confirm what it understood.

general_dontcare.description: The user says they do not care which option is chosen.

general_explain.description: The user did not understand the assistant and asks it to explain or rephrase.

general_joke.description: The user asks the assistant to tell a joke.

general_negate.description: The user says the assistant misunderstood or got the request wrong.

general_praise.description: The user praises or thanks the assistant for doing well.

general_repeat.description: The user asks the assistant to repeat what it just said.

iot_cleaning.description: The user wants to start or control a cleaning robot or vacuum cleaner.

iot_coffee.description: The user wants to make coffee with a coffee machine.

iot_hue_lightchange.description: The user wants to change the color of the lights.

iot_hue_lightdim.description: The user wants to dim the lights.

iot_hue_lightoff.description: The user wants to turn the lights off.

iot_hue_lighton.description: The user wants to turn the lights on.

iot_hue_lightup.description: The user wants to make the lights brighter.

iot_wemo_off.description: The user wants to turn off a smart plug or the device connected to it.

iot_wemo_on.description: The user wants to turn on a smart plug or the device connected to it.

lists_createoradd.description: The user wants to create a list or add an item to a list.

lists_query.description: The user asks what is on one of their lists.

lists_remove.description: The user wants to remove an item or a whole list.

music_likeness.description: The user says they like the music or song that is playing.

music_query.description: The user asks about the song, artist or music that is playing.

music_settings.description: The user wants to change a music playback setting such as shuffle or repeat.

news_query.description: The user asks for the latest news.

play_audiobook.description: The user wants to play or control an audiobook.

play_game.description: The user wants to play a game.

play_music.description: The user wants to play a song, artist or music.

play_podcasts.description: The user wants to play or control a podcast.

play_radio.description: The user wants to listen to a radio station.

qa_currency.description: The user asks about currencies or exchange rates.

qa_definition.description: The user asks for the definition of a word or term.

qa_factoid.description: The user asks a general knowledge question.

qa_maths.description: The user asks a math question or calculation.

qa_stock.description: The user asks about stock prices or the stock market.

recommendation_events.description: The user asks for recommendations of events happening nearby.

recommendation_locations.description: The user asks for recommendations of places to go, such as restaurants.

recommendation_movies.description: The user asks for movie recommendations or movie tickets.

social_post.description: The user wants to post something on social media.

social_query.description: The user asks about updates or messages on social media.

takeaway_order.description: The user wants to order takeaway food.

takeaway_query.description: The user asks about takeaway options or the status of a food order.

transport_query.description: The user asks for directions, travel times or public transport information.

transport_taxi.description: The user wants to book a taxi.

transport_ticket.description: The user wants to book or buy a travel ticket.

transport_traffic.description: The user asks about traffic conditions.

weather_query.description: The user asks about the weather.
